name: task-runs-on-the-calling-thread
why: submit runs the task itself instead of queueing it: not a pool.

name: submit-does-not-wake-a-worker
why: a sleeping worker is never told that there is a task.

name: shutdown-does-not-wake-the-workers
why: the sleeping workers never see the stop flag: shutdown waits for them for ever.

name: shutdown-drops-the-queued-tasks
why: the workers leave as soon as the stop flag is set, with tasks still in the queue.

edits.old:
wake_.wait(lock, [this] { return stopping_ || !queue_.empty(); });
                if (queue_.empty()) return;  // stopping, and every queued task has been taken: done

name: submit-after-shutdown-is-accepted
why: the task is queued although no worker will ever take it.

edits.old: if (stopping_) throw std::runtime_error("the pool has been shut down");

name: one-worker-too-few
why: the pool starts n - 1 workers: tasks that wait for each other never finish.

name: a-thread-for-every-task
why: each task gets a new detached thread; the workers do nothing.

name: std-async-instead-of-a-pool
why: std::async hides a thread per task: no pool at all (the Clean tier looks for it).

name: submit-without-the-lock
why: the queue is changed by several threads at once: a data race.

edits.new:
if (stopping_) throw std::runtime_error("the pool has been shut down");
            queue_.push_back([task] { (*task)(); });

name: idle-workers-spin
why: a worker without work loops (unlock, yield, lock) instead of sleeping.

edits.old:
wake_.wait(lock, [this] { return stopping_ || !queue_.empty(); });
                if (queue_.empty()) return;  // stopping, and every queued task has been taken: done

name: parallel-map-results-in-the-wrong-order
why: the results are collected back to front.

edits.old:
for (std::future<R>& future : futures) out.push_back(future.get());
    return out;
edits.new:
for (std::size_t i = futures.size(); i-- > 0;) out.push_back(futures[i].get());
    return out;

name: wait-without-a-predicate
why: the worker waits for any wake-up and does not check the queue (Clean tier, and a lost wake-up).
